content:
maria: quick q — I'm about to open a TF change to add a rotation grace window annotation for ExternalSecrets in payments. idea is to set secrets.redwood.com/rotation-grace=\"30s\" so k8s projected volumes have a tiny buffer before pods see a rotated secret. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/diff/4321
jong: can you paste the snippet? wondering how it interacts with refreshInterval and our sidecar logic
maria: here — in the extsecret manifest we add:
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payments-db-creds
  annotations:
    secrets.redwood.com/rotation-grace: "30s"
spec:
  refreshInterval: "1m"
  target:
    template:
      metadata:
        labels:
          app: payments
      type: Opaque
```
alejandro: hm. refreshInterval 1m + 30s grace seems fine. main worry: projected volume consumers might still read old file if kubelet hasn't remounted. grace won't force remount but gives consumers time to handle chase-down.
samir: also think about race with token rotation for the service account used by ExternalSecrets. If the secret provider pod gets restarted during rotation we could see a brief miss. Do we want jitter on grace across replicas?
maria: good point. I was thinking set a per-secret grace annotation — ops can tune. default 30s. we could add a small jitter in controller config later.
jong: another thing: helm chart for payments has an init container that reads creds into env at startup. If secret file updates later, app won't pick up env changes. For long-lived processes we need a rollout plan or a lifecycle hook.
maria: yeah I added a note in PR to add a preStop signal that triggers a rolling restart via the operator for deployments that mount projected secrets. see comment in PR.
infra-bot: [plan] terraform plan complete for env=staging — 2 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy :white_check_mark:
alejandro: quick smoke I ran in staging — applied extsecret, controller updated the secret, pods with projected volume logged: 
```
2026-03-17T15:12:03Z external-secrets-controller: refreshed secret payments-db-creds
2026-03-17T15:12:34Z kubelet: updated projected volume for pod payments-0
```
noticed app didn't pick up creds because env was populated at start. Restarting deployment picked it up.
samir: then plan: 1) add grace annotation 2) add note to helm chart docs to use a sidecar or implement SIGHUP handler for creds 3) create a canary rollout for payments with 5% traffic shift during first day.
maria: I've updated PR description with the three-step rollout and a staging smoke test checklist. pinging @jack for code review when you have a sec: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4321
jack: on it. will review tonight. quick glance — maybe set refreshInterval -> "30s" for payments instead of 1m when paired with 30s grace, to reduce window.
jong: +1 to sync refreshInterval down for critical services. but watch write amplification to secrets backend.
maria: noted. will make refreshInterval configurable via helm values in the payments chart.
jack: approved with one comment about the annotation name (maybe use external-secrets.redwood.com/rotation-grace to avoid collision). otherwise LGTM.
maria: thanks — updating now and will merge after infra tests pass.
infra-bot: [apply] applied in staging: resources created externalsecret/payments-db-creds :white_check_mark:
alejandro: staging smoke checklist passed (mount + restart -> app reads new creds). adding the post-apply note to PR.
samir: reminder: after merge, follow the canary plan — ops will watch for 429s and kubelet remount latency.
maria: merging now. thx all.
jack: thanks — will follow up tomorrow for a debrief if any unexpected rotation churn shows up. :thumbsup:
